snippet.title: My Town : Home - New Trailer
snippet.description:
We've just renovated our house and listened to your suggestions! Head on over to check out everything we changed, but if you just can't bear to wait, here's a list of what's new for you:

*New Design for Parents Room with double cribs!
*Bigger living room and kitchen to accommodate more people! This means more chairs, more food, and even an extra corner for kids!
*The entire yard has been re-designed and it now includes a sand box, benches, and many more!
*And before we forget, we have new pets!

Our other games have also received a make-over! This time, we've got more characters, clothes, and of course, pets! Feel free to check them out because we won't stop giving you more and more adventures! Thank you and happy role-playing!

Update now: https://my-town.com/game/home
